tools.name: axcient_get_organization
tools.description: Return the partner organization that the API key belongs to. Use it to confirm the connection. Axcient API: GET /organization.

tools.name: axcient_list_clients
tools.description: List the clients (customer accounts) of the partner organization, with their health status and device counters. Start here to find a client_id. Axcient API: GET /client.

tools.name: axcient_get_client
tools.description: Return one client by its id. Axcient API: GET /client/{client_id}.

tools.name: axcient_get_client_usage
tools.description: Return the local, vault and cloud storage usage of one client. Axcient API: GET /client/{client_id}/usage.

tools.name: axcient_list_appliances
tools.description: List the x360Recover appliances (on-premise backup servers) of the organization. Axcient API: GET /appliance.

tools.name: axcient_get_appliance
tools.description: Return one appliance by its id. Axcient API: GET /appliance/{appliance_id}.

tools.name: axcient_list_vaults
tools.description: List the vaults of the organization, with health status, storage use and replicated devices. Axcient API: GET /vault.

tools.name: axcient_get_vault
tools.description: Return one vault by its id, with its health, storage and devices. Axcient API: GET /vault/{vault_id}.

tools.name: axcient_get_vault_connectivity_threshold
tools.description: Return the connectivity threshold that the vault uses for its alerts. Read only: this tool does not change it. Axcient API: GET /vault/{vault_id}/threshold/connectivity.

tools.name: axcient_list_devices
tools.description: List the protected devices (servers, workstations) of the organization, with health status, usage and vaults. Axcient API: GET /device.

tools.name: axcient_get_device
tools.description: Return one protected device by its id: health, thresholds, usage, vaults and jobs. Axcient API: GET /device/{device_id}.

tools.name: axcient_get_device_autoverify
tools.description: Return the AutoVerify results (automatic restore tests) for one device. Axcient API: GET /device/{device_id}/autoverify.

tools.name: axcient_list_device_restore_points
tools.description: List the restore points of one device, grouped by the cloud vaults it is replicated to. Use it to check the latest recovery point. Axcient API: GET /device/{device_id}/restore_point.

tools.name: axcient_list_device_jobs
tools.description: List the jobs of one device under one client. Start here to find a job_id. Axcient API: GET /client/{client_id}/device/{device_id}/job.

tools.name: axcient_get_job
tools.description: Return one job by its id. Axcient API: GET /client/{client_id}/device/{device_id}/job/{job_id}.

tools.name: axcient_get_job_history
tools.description: List the run history of one job: status, start and end time, and error message per run. Use it to find failed backups. Axcient API: GET /client/{client_id}/device/{device_id}/job/{job_id}/history.

tools.name: axcient_list_users
tools.description: List the users related to the organization: name, role, active state and last login. Axcient API: GET /user.

tools.name: axcient_get_user
tools.description: Return one user by its id. Axcient API: GET /user/{user_id}.
